correctness.rationale: Formal BDF Taylor expansion proves the index-two sharp obstructions, including BDF6 impossibility. Exact rational recurrence proves endpoint signs through index 999; exact Schur radius checks give analytic powers in enlarged disks; Cauchy plus binomial-coefficient estimates prove remaining infinite tail signs. Positive fractional power composition strictly fills the ranges below endpoints. The accompanying standalone verifier rederives and replays all critical rational computations from the public polynomial definitions.

value.rationale: All-index negativity of CQ history weights is a concrete structural condition in discrete comparison and energy arguments for fractional dynamics, explicitly appearing as an assumption in the inspected nonlinear subdiffusion literature. Sharp higher BDF admissibility intervals, the BDF6 impossibility, and analytic certificates over every coefficient are substantive facts beyond finite sign exploration; no general positivity or stability of an assembled solver is asserted.
